messages:
pagerduty: [ALERT] Service: inference-edge — High 5xx rate detected on /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1. Triggered at 12:10 UTC. Incident ID: INC-1765553333. https://pagerduty/redwood/INC-1765553333

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: page fired for oncall@squad-inference (escalation policy: inference-critical)

sasha: acked. I'm on it — pulling logs and traffic split now.

kevin: seeing a sharp jump in 5xx at 12:09:50 -> 12:11:30. Canary traffic was ramping from 5% -> 25% in eu-west-1. p50 latency normal, p95 +40%.

maya: any customer-facing errors? Error class?

sasha: initial quick check: mostly 502/503s from embed workers. A subset of requests hit a new compiled kernel path (quantized) on canary pods. grabbing pod logs.

kevin: log sample:
```
2026-03-15T12:09:57Z embed-worker-xyz kernel_executor.cpp:142 failed to load kernel: KVCache mismatch, falling back -> error
ERROR: serve: stream closed with code=INTERNAL message="embedding compute failed"
```

sasha: ok. I'm going to stop the canary ramp and divert traffic back to stable while we investigate. Executing traffic control now.

sasha: command I ran:
```
# pause canary ramp and pin traffic to stable
redwoodctl rollout pause --deployment=embed-edge --region=eu-west-1 --reason="5xx spike on canary"
redwoodctl traffic set --deployment=embed-edge --region=eu-west-1 --canary-weight=0
```

oncall-bot: action recorded: rollout paused by sasha. PagerDuty note: acknowledged by sasha.

pagerduty: [ACK] INC-1765553333 acknowledged by sasha at 12:12 UTC. Escalation halted.

kevin: after diverting, error rate dropped to baseline within ~60s. Canary pods still showing kernel load errors in logs — sounds like a model runtime/kernel mismatch on the new image.

maya: can we do a quick rollback of the canary image to previous working digest to be safe?

sasha: yes. Rolling back canary image to embed-edge:v1.9.3 (previous).

sasha: rollback command:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embed-edge embed-worker=registry.redwood/embed-edge:v1.9.3 --record
# watch rollout
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/embed-edge -w
```

kevin: confirming: the problematic image was v1.10.0-quant; v1.9.3 had no kernel path changes. Looks like a regression in the quant kernel selection.

ops-lead: good catch. Please tag exact pod IDs and the faulty image so we can block further promotions until patch.

sasha: tagged pods and image: embed-worker-xyz (sha: a1b2c3d4), embed-worker-abc (sha: a1b2c3d4). Faulty image: registry.redwood/embed-edge:v1.10.0-quant.

pagerduty: [RESOLVE] Incident INC-1765553333 resolved at 12:22 UTC — 12 minute incident. Post-incident: reduced 5xx back to baseline after traffic diversion + rollback.

maya: quick customer impact summary for ticketing/CS?

sasha: summary draft:
- timeframe: 12:09:50 UTC — 12:22:00 UTC
- region: eu-west-1
- scope: canary traffic for embed-edge deployment affected (canary weight ramped up to ~25%)
- impact: ~2.3% of embed requests returned 5xx during peak window. Affected endpoints: /v1/embeddings (bulk batches most impacted).
- customer impact: transient failed embedding requests for a small subset of customers (approx 40 accounts saw errors; top affected: acme-marketing, beta-shop). Retries succeeded after rollback for most.
- root cause (initial): regression in kernel selection path in embed-edge:v1.10.0-quant causing compute failures under certain input shapes.
- mitigation: paused canary ramp, diverted traffic to stable, rolled back to v1.9.3; monitoring confirmed recovery within ~60s after traffic change.

kevin: +1. We'll create a blocking bug against the quant kernel change and run pre-rollout canary tests with synthetic shapes that hit that codepath.

ops-lead: action items:
- [sasha] add exact pod logs + traces to INC ticket (due EOD)
- [kevin] file regression bug and add unit/integration tests for the kernel path (due tomorrow)
- [platform] add auto-revert policy: if 5xx rate > 1% for 2 consecutive minutes during canary ramp, auto-pause and notify oncall (ops meeting to scope)
- [sasha -> kevin] handoff oncall for next 2h for monitoring and follow-up

sasha: handing off: I'm done active mitigation. @kevin you have oncall for the next 2 hours. I'll stay nearby if you need context. :thumbsup:

kevin: taking handoff. I'll watch eu-west metrics and the canary promotion gates.

maya: thanks team. Let's make sure CS has the incident summary for outreach. If any customers require higher touch, ops will route.

ops-lead: filing an internal postmortem checklist and scheduling a deep-dive tomorrow. Closing thread, leaving notes in INC-1765553333. :white_check_mark:
